verdict.rationale: Turso documents a Platform API reference for programmatically managing databases, groups, organizations, and tokens, so an API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
